items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: The interviewee mentions John Porter in the context of David Jones bringing him into the band ('David got John Porter') and discusses a contest where John Porter played with another band ('John Porter was playing with some of the bands. ctx.x: old could go on a dance nowadays. You know that. Yeah. And I played with Punch. A long time. Kid Punch. That was Punch's band here, huh? Yeah, that was Punch's band. Was that after Jesse Jackson

or before? No. After Jesse Jackson, I went at Punch. I stayed at Punch a long time here. I left Punch. I went with this same band here. Ridgely's Tuxedo. With Baby Eric.
